book.name: Efesios
book.title: CART DANꞋ BZOJ POSTLW SAN PABLO C̱HE BEṈEꞋ CAꞋ ŽEꞋ EFESO

content: Na' le'e bidao', ḻe gwzenag c̱he x̱axṉa'le, ḻe can' cheyaḻa' gon chio' naccho txen len X̱ancho Criston'.

Cate' Diosen' bnežjue' x̱ozxta'oto' ca' ley c̱hen', gwne': “Ḻe gap baḻa'aṉ x̱axṉa'le.” Na' goquen da' nechw da' bžie' bia' yesone' da' nsa' to da' güen da' gone' len ḻegaque' še yosozenague' c̱hen, gwne': “Ḻe gap bala'aṉ x̱axṉa'le
cont gac güen c̱hele na' cont banḻe sša ḻo yezlio nga.”
Na' le'e nita' xi'iṉle, ḻe yosgol ḻe yosc̱ha'o bi' c̱hele ca' binḻo, diža' šagüe' gwzejni'ile ḻegacbe' cont yosozenagbe' c̱he X̱ancho Criston' na' gague con gonḻe ga yeseža'a yeselocbe'.
Na' le'e mos, ḻe gwzenag c̱he x̱an žin c̱helen' do laže'le na' ḻe yeyiljwlaže' naquen' gonḻe da' yesazlaže' to toe', ḻe ḻecze chzenagle c̱he Criston' caten' chzenagle c̱hegaque'.
Ḻe gwzenag c̱hegaque' do yic̱hj do laže'le, gague cate'zen' cheseṉe'e can' chonḻen', ḻe nacle beṉe' güen xšin Criston', na' can' chaclaže' Diosen' goncho.
Na' cheyaḻa' güe'laže'cho goncho žin c̱he beṉe' cont yebe X̱ancho Criston' chio', gague cont yebe beṉe' nac x̱an žin na'ze.
Goncho ca', ḻe ṉezecho bite'teze da' güen da' choncho, X̱ancho Criston' gone' cont žin ža yebi'in güen len chio', chio' naccho esclavos na' len chio' bi naccho esclavos.

Na' le'e nacle beṉe' x̱an žin, ḻe gon güen len beṉe' ca' cheson xšinḻe. Bitw co'ole ḻegaque' šeb, ḻe X̱ancho Diosen' zoe' yaban' chṉa'cze' can' chonḻen', na' ḻecze chṉa'cze' can' cheson beṉe' güen žin c̱helen', na' toz can' chone' len yogo'ḻoḻ beṉe' note'teze zjanaque'.
Can' goncho cont Satanásen' bi gonen chio' gan
Nachen' beṉe' migw, da' naccho txen len X̱ancho Criston', cheyaḻa' soac̱hac̱hcho šejnilaže'chone', ḻe nape' yeḻa' guac xen cont chaclene' chio'.
Cheyaḻa' gon cuincho gual doxen can' chaclaže' Diosen' goncho, cont soac̱hac̱hcho bi šejḻe'cho c̱he Satanás dan' chnabia' da' x̱igüe' ca' cate' chyiljwlažen' siyen' chio'.

Ḻe gague beṉe' nac bela' chenṉa' chdiḻlencho, san chdiḻlencho da' x̱igüe' ca', da' ca' besyeyaquen da' mal, na' bichle da' chesenabia' beṉe' že' yežlio nga beṉe' nc̱hoḻ yic̱hjlažda'ogaque' len da' malen'. Chdiḻlencho yogo'ḻoḻ spiritw mal ca' gate'teze chesašen.

Da'nan' cheyaḻa' gon cuincho gual doxen can' chaclaže' Diosen', cont Satanásen' bi soeczen chio' ža cate' tiḻlenen chio'. Na' cate' ba bencho can' chazlaže' Diosen', nach cheyaḻa' soac̱hac̱hcho len ḻe'.

Na' cont soac̱hac̱hcho bi siye' Satanásen' chio', cheyaḻa' güe'cho diža' ḻi yogo' ṉi'a. Na' še goncho ca', gaclenen chio' ca da' chc̱hej soldadon' cho'a ḻi'e. Na' cheyaḻa' goncho da' nac güen yogo' ṉi'a, ḻe še goncho ca', gwcue'ejen chio' ca xa soldadon' da' naquen de ya chcue'ejen cho'alc̱ho'e.

Na' cheyaḻa' soacho probnidw güe'lencho beṉe' diža' güen c̱he Criston' da' chzejni'in can' guac soacho binḻo len Diosen'. Na' še soacho probnidw güe'lenchon beṉe', gaclenen chio' can' chaclen xel soldadon' ḻe'.

Na' da' zejechen ca bichle da' goncho, cheyaḻa' soac̱hac̱hcho šejnilaže'cho Diosen'. Na' še soac̱hac̱hcho šejnilaže'chone', nach gaclenen chio' cont bi gwzenagcho c̱he Satanásen'. Gaclenen chio' ca escudo da' chc̱hin soldadon' chaclenen ḻe', chosolen yi' c̱he flechas ca' da' chesaḻa'ṉiṉen zja'aquen gan' zien', na' chcue'ejen ḻe' len da' ca' zja'ac yeseyidjon cuerp c̱hen'.

Na' cheyaḻa' yosa'laže'cho Criston' ba beṉe' yeḻa' mban c̱hecho toḻi tocaṉe, cont gaclenen chio' ca chaclen lapa' de ya da' chc̱hin soldadon'. Na' ḻecze Xtiža' Diosen' da' ben Spiritw c̱he Diosen' cont nyojen, ḻe gonchgua xbab c̱hen cont gaquen len le'e ca to spada da' chc̱hin soldadon'.

Na' do tiemp cheyaḻa' yoḻ güižcho Diosen' ṉabcho yogo' da' chzejni'i Spiritw c̱hen' chio'. Na' cheyaḻa' gaccho beṉe' banḻaže' na' yoḻ güižchone' sin cbi yeche'echo, ṉabcho gaclene' yogo' beṉe' ba gwleje' cont zjanaque' ḻo ne'e.
Na' ḻe ṉab goṉ Diosen' latje gua' xtižen', na' ḻe ṉab bi žeba' gua' diža' tcho'a gwzejni'ida' beṉe' diža' güen c̱he Criston' da' nono gwṉeze cani'.
Ḻe Diosen' gwseḻe' neda' ca gualaze' cont bia' xtižen', na' da'nan' dia' ḻižya nga. Nachen' ḻe ṉabe Diosen' gaclene' neda' bi žeba' gua' xtižen' tcho'a can' cheyaḻa' guan'.
Pablon' chone' c̱hac̱h laže'gaque'

Chseḻa' beṉe' migw c̱hecho Tíquico güe'e diža' doxen can' chac cont ṉezele can' chac c̱hia' na' yogo' da' chona'. Chaquecho Tíquicon' da' naque' txen len chio' chonxencho Criston' na' zoateze' chone' xšin X̱ancho Criston' can' cheyaḻa' gone'.
Nachen' chseḻa'ne' cont ṉezele can' chac c̱heto' na' cont gone' c̱hac̱h laže'le.

Chṉaba' lao X̱acho Diosen' len X̱ancho Jesucriston' yesonšque' cont yogo'le chonxenle Criston' soa cuezle binḻo len yic̱hjlažda'olen', na' ḻecze yesonšque' cont yogo'le gaque ḻježle na' soac̱hac̱hle šejnilaže'lene'.
Soašcacze Diosen' gaclene' yogo' beṉe' chesacde' X̱ancho Jesucriston' sin cbi yesebeze'. Da' na'zen' chzoja'.
